data.name: Kalipada
data.gender_notes: Kalipada is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kalipada is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Kali' meaning black and 'pada' meaning foot. The name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as having black skin and is referred to as Kali. Thus, Kalipada can be interpreted as the 'Black-footed God'. The name Kalipada carries the meaning “Black God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Kalipada usually hope their child will grow to embody black god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kalipada signifies devotion and dedication to Lord Shiva, who is the embodiment of time and change. It represents the deep connection one has with the divine and the spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Kalipada belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Black God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalipada total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
